sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio. All photos and videos to be attached to the end-of-shift report.
Morning debrief with Night Shift regarding the early-morning status of the CBD.
Debrief completed; suiting up for deployment and patrols.
Commencing Delta Route; welfare check on stores along Queen Street towards Fort Street, all clear:
Welfare check at Mecca, Dangerfield, the new Ippondo branch next to Dangerfield (not yet open, renovations ongoing), Lush, the former NZ Muscle premises, 2degrees, all clear.

Welfare check of the Durham Street West alleyway and businesses within the vicinity: Hazy Tiger, BBQ King Restaurant, Kym's Unit, Borderless International Group, Caring Clinic Doctors, Adina City Life, all clear.
Welfare check of the Durham Street East alleyway and businesses within the vicinity, all clear:
Welfare check of Vulcan Lane and businesses within the vicinity, all clear:
Welfare check at Partridge Jewellery, Pandora, Queens Jewellery, Sail Away Souvenirs, Michael Hill, all clear.
Welfare check at Kathmandu, Macpac, Art Gallery, Faradays, all clear.
Welfare check at Taco Bell, Shortland Mini Mart, BNZ Place, the BNZ building entrance on Shortland Street, Partridge Jewellery, Pocket Park, all clear.
Arrived at check-in corner of Fort Street and Fort Lane, all clear.
Walkthrough of Fort Lane with welfare checks on stores, all clear:
Mistry Shoe Repair and Key Cutting
Dilworth Building entrance Customs Street East
Arrived at check-in Commercial Bay; full sweep around the area, all clear.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, Starbucks, Kowhai Cafe, Adidas, Movenpick Hotel, all clear.
77 Convenience Store corner of Commerce and Quay Street
Standing by to show presence to morning commuters and the public before moving to the next checkpoint for Delta Route.
Leaving standby and commencing a sweep towards High Street.
Welfare check on stores along lower High Street towards Lorne Street, all clear:
Welfare check at Coco Lane, all clear:
Welfare check on stores along Lorne Street; standing by under shelter due to pouring rain while remaining vigilant and awaiting response calls.
Continuing welfare checks while trying to stay dry under shelter due to the rain; checks will be conducted slower than usual.

Welfare checks interrupted by a response call from Partridge Jewellery regarding a female individual who appears to be under the influence of narcotics — described as wearing a light grey hoodie and black track pants with mud or faeces on them, holding a brown paper bag; harmless, but our assistance requested to check if she is alright.
Arrived at the response call; staff informed us she had left via Pocket Park / Jean Batten Avenue towards Fort Street.
Sweeping towards Fort Street, corner of Commerce Street and Fort Street.
No sign of her at Fort Lane from eye view.

Swept through Wilson Carpark, Fort Street, with an eye view from the corner of Commerce and Fort Street; no sign of the individual. Continuing patrols while keeping an eye out in case we run into her.
Commencing welfare checks again at Lorne Street while remaining vigilant for the female individual, all clear:
Arrived at check-in corner of Wellesley Street East and Lorne Street, all clear.
Arrived at check-in corner of Rutland Street and Wakefield Street, all clear. Standing by under shelter due to rain.
Response call regarding a male individual displaying suspicious behaviour inside Lush; assistance requested to move him along.
Arrived at the response call; the male individual had left, and staff described him as behaving in an unsettling manner.
Standing by to show presence in case the individual circles back around.
Continuing welfare checks slowly under shelter, all clear:
Arrived at check-in Skyworld Entertainment Centre, all clear.
Welfare check by eye view from afar of Jack's Fried Chicken, Jack's Cafeteria, The Terrace, Aotea Centre and Cafe and Bar, all within proximity of each other in the same vicinity, all clear.
Arrived at check-in Auckland Town Hall, all clear.
Queens Food Court and all restaurants within
Tanuki Japanese Sake and Sushi Bar
Ending Delta Route at the corner of the Library, Rutland Street and Lorne Street, and commencing Beta Route.
Arrived at check-in corner of Rutland Street and Wakefield Street, all clear.
Best Chef Noodle and Cold Dishes
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male individual inside the premises being aggressive and loud; assistance requested to move him along.
Arrived at the response call; the male individual had already left by bus from the stop in front of McDonald's. Standing by to show presence.
Response call from Books on High — a female individual stole a purse on display and was last seen heading down lower High Street; staff will send a picture so we can try to track the individual down.
Arrived at lower High Street, sweeping into Fort Street and Commerce Street, lower Fort Street.
Swept the area for the female individual; no sign of her anywhere. Returning to routes while remaining vigilant for the individuals we have received calls about.
Arrived at the check-in for Echo Route, Queen's Arcade, all clear.
Welfare check at Western Union Money Exchange, Q Convenience Store, Cookes, Fable, Luxury Karaoke, Quest, all clear.
Welfare check and sweep through Imperial Lane inside the premises, all clear.
Arrived at check-in corner of Shortland Street and Queen Street, all clear.
Arrived at check-in corner of Victoria Street West and Albert Street; standing by to show presence.
Welfare check at the Te Waihorotiu train station exit along Victoria Street West, all clear.
Wilson Carpark food stalls Elliott Street
Arrived at check-in corner of Darby Street and Queen Street, all clear.
Standing by to show presence while remaining vigilant and awaiting response calls or incidents.
Response call from Remedy Cafe regarding a drunk male individual in their store; assistance requested to move him along.
Arrived at the response call; the individual had left, described as having one arm. Leaving the response call.
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key. All photos and videos to be attached to the end-of-shift report.
Standing by at HQ charging the Ops Phone due to low battery percentage.

Arrived outside Hallensteins, Queen Street; welfare checks on stores along Queen Street between HQ and Wyndham Street complete, no issues reported. Standing by maintaining a strong presence for members of the public and the surrounding stores.
Leaving the standby area; no issues or response calls occurred.

Arrived at lower Queen Street — Swarovski reported a female individual stole two earrings approximately 10–15 minutes earlier, last seen heading up Queen Street. Patrolling back up Queen Street to try to get a visual of the person of interest.
Response call from Mountain Warehouse regarding a female individual who stole from their store, last seen walking down Queen Street towards TK Square.

Came into contact with the female person of interest who stole from Mountain Warehouse; informed her she had to hand over the stolen items and she complied. Stolen items retrieved, no issues to report.
Arrived at Mountain Warehouse to hand over the stolen items; standing by.
Continuing patrols while looking out for the person of interest from Swarovski.
Arrived at Fort Street; commencing a full sweep, as there had been a group of vagrants outside Vape Haven but they have left the area.

Full sweep complete, no sign of the person of interest. Informed by Police that they are also looking for the same individual but have no visual on her either. Heading up to Chancery Square / Freyberg Square.

Arrived at Chancery Square / Freyberg Square; full sweep of Chancery Square, Freyberg Square, O'Connell Street and High Street. No visual of the person of interest; continuing patrols to Lorne Street.
Arrived at Lorne Street; commencing a full sweep down to Auckland Library.

Arrived at Auckland Library; full sweep of Lorne Street and welfare checks on stores complete, no issues to report. Full sweep of Auckland Library also complete, no issues. Still no visual of the person of interest from Swarovski; will continue to look out for her while on patrols.
Arrived at Aotea Square; commencing a full sweep.

Full sweep complete, no issues to report, and welfare checks on stores within the area all clear. Standing by for security presence and on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Leaving the standby area; no issues or problematic vagrants occurred within the area.
Arrived at Elliott Street; welfare check on Elliott Stables, no issues to report. Standing by for security presence.
Leaving the standby area; no issues to report.

Arrived at the McDonald's Queen Street check-in; staff reported a person of interest stole food off their counter at approximately 16:00 this afternoon. Standing by outside McDonald's Queen Street for any nearby response calls and to provide security presence for members of the public and surrounding businesses.
Leaving the standby area; no issues to report.
Arrived at Darby Street; welfare check on stores, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Albert Street and Victoria Street West; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear.
Arrived at the top of Victoria Street West check-in.
Welfare checks on stores at the top of Victoria Street West complete, no issues reported. Standing by for security presence for surrounding businesses and members of the public.
Response call from Tanuki, Queen Street, regarding a male yelling racist comments in public; assistance requested. No description was received as staff heard but did not see the person of interest.

Interacted with a male who spoke to us about having been assaulted, without us knowing he was the person of interest Tanuki called about. With no description given, we could not identify him until members of the public informed us that the male claiming to have been assaulted was the person of interest; he had by then gone down towards Queen Street.
Arrived at HQ; commencing floor checks.
Arrived at TK Square; welfare check on McDonald's Britomart, no issues brought to our attention. Standing by for security presence and on the lookout for any problematic issues within the area.
Leaving the standby area; no issues occurred.
Arrived at the Gore Street check-in; commencing a full sweep down to Jean Batten Street.
Arrived at Jean Batten Street; welfare check on stores, all clear.
Arrived at the High Street check-in, all clear.
Arrived at the Chancery Square / Freyberg Square check-in, all clear. Standing by for security presence for restaurant customers.
Leaving the standby area; no issues occurred. Heading back to HQ to charge the Ops Phone.
Response call from Albert Mart Convenience Store requesting assistance with a male who was attempting to shoplift at that moment.

Arrived at Albert Mart; the shopkeeper informed us the male had tried to run out of the store, but the shopkeeper had closed and locked the door. All stolen items were returned, and we informed the male he had to leave the premises; he complied and left without issues. Police were contacted at the same time; standing by as he remained outside the store.
Police arrived and the male was detained; standing by in case Police require assistance.
The male was released as the incident was deemed not major, with all items returned; standing by while he is released from handcuffs.
Heading back to HQ for a 30-minute break.
Arrived at HQ for a 30-minute break.
Standing by at HQ for Night Shift handover.
Afternoon shift concluded. Auror reports processed.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio. All photos and videos to be attached to the end-of-shift report.

Remained at HQ awaiting the Ops Phone to reach a sufficient battery level before commencing patrol duties; prepared for deployment and maintained readiness for any incoming security assistance requests.

Team deployed with the Ops Phone at a reasonable battery percentage. Commenced foot patrol towards Upper Queen Street, monitoring surrounding businesses, public activity and nearby streets; normal late-night pedestrian movement observed, no concerns identified.

Received a WhatsApp message from Jo & Joes regarding a banned patron; acknowledged the information and confirmed the team would remain vigilant and monitor for the individual during patrols. (Screenshot on file.)

Received a phone call from Radisson RED advising that their security personnel might require assistance with the removal of a guest; hotel staff advised a follow-up call would be made if additional support was required. Acknowledged and confirmed the team would remain available and ready to respond.
Continued foot patrol towards Lower Queen Street, monitoring pedestrian movements, surrounding businesses and public areas; routine late-night activity with no unusual behaviour observed.

Received a follow-up phone call from Radisson RED requesting immediate security assistance with a guest removal; acknowledged, responded promptly and commenced travel towards the hotel to provide additional support.

While en route to Radisson RED, received another phone call advising that security assistance was no longer required — hotel security confirmed the guest had been successfully removed from the premises without further issues. Acknowledged the update and stood down from the response.
Resumed routine foot patrol towards Lower Queen Street following the cancellation of the assistance request; continued monitoring surrounding streets and businesses.

Arrived at Commercial Bay and conducted a general observation of the surrounding area; public activity relatively quiet with minimal pedestrian movement. Checked on McDonald's Britomart — staff had no security concerns or incidents to report.
Maintained a standby position while remaining available for incoming operational phone calls; continued monitoring the surrounding area.

Continued foot patrol along Quay Street towards the Viaduct Harbour entertainment precinct; minimal pedestrian movement, with most bars and nightclubs experiencing low patron activity. Danny Doolan's was noticeably busier than surrounding establishments; their security personnel appeared to have the venue and patron activity under control, with no additional assistance required.

Heavy rainfall commenced, significantly affecting outdoor conditions and pedestrian activity. Continued foot patrol towards Wyndham Street despite the adverse weather, conducting visual checks of nearby late-night businesses; no issues reported. (Footage on file documenting the heavy rainfall.)

Conducted a security check at the 77 Convenience Store on Albert Street; staff confirmed no security concerns or incidents requiring assistance. Continued a thorough foot patrol through surrounding streets and the SkyCity precinct; no suspicious activity or disturbances identified.

Arrived at the Aotea precinct and conducted a general security assessment; heavy rainfall continued and public activity remained very low. No disturbances, suspicious behaviour or security concerns identified.

Proceeded towards Fort Lane and conducted a security check at Jo & Joes; staff confirmed no incidents or concerns requiring assistance. Continued patrol along Customs Street and nearby surrounding roads; most streets largely deserted due to the ongoing heavy rainfall.

Conducted foot patrol along High Street and inspected the Chancery Square precinct; extremely low pedestrian activity, with the area largely deserted due to persistent heavy rain. No concerns identified.

Completed an additional foot patrol through the remaining sections of High Street and Lorne Street; pedestrian activity remained minimal due to the heavy rainfall. All inspected areas quiet at the time of patrol.

Commenced the return to HQ following completion of scheduled patrol duties. Due to prolonged exposure to heavy rainfall, team uniforms and operational equipment were heavily soaked, and the Ops Phone battery had decreased to a low percentage requiring recharging.
Arrived at HQ; commenced drying wet uniforms and equipment, connected the Ops Phone to the charger and commenced a rest break while equipment was attended to. Remained at HQ pending shift completion.
Night shift concluded; handover to the incoming Morning Shift completed, with no outstanding security incidents requiring further intervention.

NOTE: Morning raw ended 'changeover to Night shift' at 14:30 — typo, corrected to Afternoon Shift.
NOTE: 21:09 Albert Mart male was detained in handcuffs by Police then released without charge — not counted as an arrest.
NOTE: 18:12 male claimed he had been assaulted (unverified, no corroboration; he was also the Tanuki POI) — not counted under serious.

NOTE: Four of the day's response subjects (Partridge narcotics female, Lush male, McDonald's aggressive male, Remedy drunk male) had left before team arrival — counted as calls only, not in person-level categories.
